mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS is increasing, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with job growth
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS is increasing and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and INDPRO is declining, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO is declining and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
